The '''dartfish''' was a type of [[Fish/Legends|fish]] that lived in the [[Ocean/Legends|sea]] among [[sea anemone]]s. The relationship between dartfish and sea anemones was comparable to the one between [[Bimmisaari tiga loreng|tiga loreng]], a [[Species/Legends|creature]] [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bimmisaari/Legends|Bimmisaari]], and the [[asaari tree]]s they nested in.<ref name="TEGtPaM" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dartfish were mentioned in the [[1998]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''.<ref name="TEGtPaM" /> In the real world, [[Wikipedia:Dartfish|dartfishes]] are a group of fish that include multiple species.<ref name="RealWorld">{{WebCite|url=https://www.livingoceansfoundation.org/dartfishes|text=Dartfishes|work=[https://www.livingoceansfoundation.org/ Khaled bin Sultan Living Oceans Foundation]|archivedate=20251116191846}}</ref>
